title: Dangerous Assignment
paragraphs: Brian Donlevy stars as government agent Steve Mitchell, sent by his unnamed commissioner on international assignments involving espionage, political intrigue, smuggling, and other threats.

International espionage/adventure drama starring Brian Donlevy as U.S. government agent Steve Mitchell. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 200 audio objects but only 102 distinct dated program dates; 93 dates preserve two differently titled/cut recordings. Four objects are explicitly unidentified and one Java file is undated with only a filename-level possible date.

GRH documents the program through Summer replacement run (July 9, 1949 to August 20, 1949) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], Regular NBC run (February 6, 1950 to February 13, 1953) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Late U.S. run (February 15, 1953 to July 8, 1953) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).
